# `armada domain`

<!-- Generated by `make docs` from the commands; do not edit. -->

[All commands](armada.md)

List and verify custom domains.

Also: `domains`.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`armada domain list`](#armada-domain-list) | List custom domains and the DNS records that prove ownership |
| [`armada domain verify`](#armada-domain-verify) | Check a domain's TXT record now |

## `armada domain list`

List custom domains and the DNS records that prove ownership.

```
armada domain list [flags]
```

Also: `ls`.

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--app string` | only domains used by this app |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |

## `armada domain verify`

Check a domain's TXT record now.

```
armada domain verify DOMAIN [flags]
```

Flags:

| Flag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-o`, `--output string` | output format: text or json (default `text`) |
